repair_authority_actions.defect: Pre-existing NameError: line referenced a local variable `state_dir` that was never a parameter of, nor assigned within, this function -- introduced in commit 747a74f ('Build 608: RCEC Closed-Loop Activation and Admissibility Repair') when `state_dir=state_dir` was added to the ReflexiveInterpreter(...) call without threading a state_dir parameter through. Silently caught by the function's own broad except-Exception handler, leaving systems['noncomp_reflexive_interpreter'] permanently None and systems['noncomp_runtime_status'] = {'available': False, 'reason': "name 'state_dir' is not defined", ...} on every boot_aurora() call, regardless of profile.
repair_authority_actions.repair_authority_basis: Criterion 3 (missing wiring / type-contract defect) plus criterion 1 (an existing producer, boot_aurora's own `systems['state_dir']`, already possessed the correct value) plus criterion 2 (ReflexiveInterpreter.__init__ already accepts state_dir: Optional[str], an existing consumer already structurally capable). No new semantics decided -- criterion 4 satisfied.
repair_authority_actions.fix: Added `_noncomp_state_dir = systems.get("state_dir")` and passed `state_dir=str(_noncomp_state_dir) if _noncomp_state_dir else None` to the existing ReflexiveInterpreter(...) call, replacing the undefined bare `state_dir`.
repair_authority_actions.verified_by: Direct boot_aurora(state_dir=..., runtime_profile='surface') call showing noncomp_runtime_status['available'] == True and noncomp_reflexive_interpreter is not None (previously False/None on every boot); aurora_representational_closed_loop_canary.py Part 2, which went from step.representational_ref == None (UNREACHABLE) to a real, non-None ref (PRESERVED) purely from this fix, with no other code changed in between the two runs.
repair_authority_actions.scope_note: This bug predates this entire representational-substrate work (all three prior directives) and predates this session's changes. It affected every boot_aurora() call, not just 'surface' profile or test patterns -- the noncomp/ReflexiveInterpreter runtime never activated in ANY real boot until this fix. Confirmed pre-existing via git log -L on the exact line: the bug was introduced in 747a74f, which never touched the function's signature.

Records the ref produced by the witness's own interpretation call, alongside (not overwriting) step.representational_ref.
